title: SFV2 Switching a Work Orders setting changes no record that already exists
expected:
1. Switching a setting on the Work Orders settings page on or off changes no record that already exists. The product states this before it saves: "No record is changed by this switch. Parts already on a work order keep the state they are in."

2. The confirmation names the setting and the direction, and states how many records the requirement affects at this location today - and that none of them is changed by the switch.

3. The setting decides how work behaves from that point on. It does not reach back over work orders, lines or parts that already exist, in either direction.

4. Nothing is ordered, picked, received or returned as a result of the switch itself.

Source:

  • QA lead ruling, 25 September 2026 - the confirmation the product itself shows when a Work Orders setting is switched is the expected behaviour: "No record is changed by this switch. Parts already on a work order keep the state they are in."
  • Epic SV-8683, story SV-9248 (Story 2, Settings apply to every work order), Simple Flow V2 specification (Confluence page 771391574).

Last checked against build v26.39.0-07c719b on 9/25/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
